figures.caption: Physical map showing the genetic organization of a 19,539-bp multibacteriocinogenic cluster present in S. infantarius LP90.Putative ORFs are represented by wide arrows indicating the direction of transcription. Small flags and loop symbols indicate putative promoters and rho-independent transcription termination regions, respectively. Horizontal arrows below the genes refer to the transcriptional and co-transcriptional units as determined by RT-PCR. Dashed arrows refer to genes not transcribed or not co-transcribed.
